newsitem.title: USA: Pax launches socially responsible open-end fund.
newsitem.headline: Pax launches socially responsible open-end fund.

text.p: Pax World Management Corp said that it has formed Pax World Fund Family, which consists of one new and one old fund committed to investing in life-supportive products and services offered by companies meeting certain criteria of social responsibility.

In a press release Friday, Pax said the fund family launched Pax World Growth Fund, an open-end fund that invests almost entirely in equity securities of established companies with above-average growth prospects seeking investment return through long-term appreciation.
The group also includes Pax World Fund, a no-load balanced fund, which was founded in 1971.
The company said it also expects to offer a money market fund in the fall.
